letter.cover_letter_markdown:
Dear Kestrel AI hiring team,
I build the tools developers reach for first. At Northbeam I took our Public API from beta to GA and grew active developers 4x, and I moved us to usage-based pricing without losing a single top account.
Agent tooling is where I want to do that next. Your SDK and CLI are the surface where a team decides whether agents are a demo or a product, and I know how to measure that moment: activation, time to first working agent, retention by cohort.
I would start by sitting with ten teams shipping agents today, then set one activation metric the whole group can rally around.
I would love to talk.
Alex Rivera
